system.name: GenDiE (Generate, Discriminate, Evolve)
system.one_liner: A self-evolving training framework that raises LLM context faithfulness by sentence-level generative and discriminative losses on self-built data.

content.variant_note: two titled phase frames (pre-stage, self-evolving stages) above a full-width checkpoint chain LLM θ0 to θ3 that carries the iterations, each hop fed by a dataset icon
content.argues: Treating each sentence as its own optimisation unit, with target and negative sentences built by the model itself each round, evolves faithfulness over successive checkpoints.
content.subject: construction of sentence-level training data for GenDiE in the pre-stage and in two self-evolving rounds, and the checkpoint chain it trains

elements.name: Original Data

elements.name: Candidate Negative Sentence Generation

elements.name: LLM θ0
elements.role: the initial model; also generates the negatives

elements.name: Negative Selection
elements.role: along the chosen path, each node and its sibling form a contrastive pair (a, a′) when S_a > S_a′

elements.name: Tree-Structured Sampling (θ2)

elements.name: Training Dataset D3

lessons.what_to_learn: Show an iterative self-training loop as phase frames above a checkpoint chain: each hop is fed by the dataset icon built in that round, and the LLM box shade darkens each round and is reused inside the panels. Box the parts of one record in red and blue to say which loss trains on which part.
lessons.suits: self-evolving or iterative training methods (self-play, iterative preference tuning, rejection sampling) that build new data each round and need both the data construction and the checkpoint timeline.

evidence: leverage models from previous iteration for both self-generation and self-scoring
each path from the root to a leaf node constitutes a complete answer
Each node a along the path, together with its sibling node a′, will compose a contrastive sentence pair

summary: GenDiE (Generate, Discriminate, Evolve) is a self-evolving training framework that improves the context faithfulness of LLMs at the level of single sentences, using generative and discriminative losses. Figure 1 has two titled frames above a checkpoint chain. Panel (a), the pre-stage, takes a QA example with passages and gold answer sentences, lets LLM θ0 write a negative sentence for each prefix, filters them and builds dataset D0. Panel (b) repeats self-evolving rounds: a tree of sampled sentences is grown with the previous model, the best path is picked by exact match, and sibling sentences become positive-negative pairs for the next dataset. Red and blue-violet boxes mark what feeds the language modeling and discrimination losses. The chain LLM θ0 to θ3, in darkening blue, shows each iteration.
summary_zh: GenDiE 在句子粒度上自我进化以提升上下文忠实度。图一分 (a) 预阶段与 (b) 自进化阶段两个框，下方是 LLM θ0 到 θ3 的检查点链；(b) 用树形采样得到正负句对，红框和蓝框标出语言建模损失与判别损失作用的位置。
notes: Prior kind stage-pipeline (closed-loop) kept; worked-walkthrough not added because only the Original Data card holds real text and the rows and tree are symbolic. Dataset labels in the drawing are D0, D2 and D3 with no D1, as printed. Reading the green and pink regions as two terminated answer paths (Answer A1, Answer A2) follows the Positive Selection frame and the text on path selection. The 3-6 pt math strings are partly bitmaps, so some tuple contents were read from the picture.
